title: 锐器与碎玻璃安全
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/029_锐器与碎玻璃安全.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/029_锐器与碎玻璃安全/src.py

points.K1: 割伤刺伤最常见，碎玻璃一碰就伤人
points.K2: 玻璃器皿用前查裂纹缺口
points.K3: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋
points.K4: 切玻璃、剪丝：戴好防护，切口朝下
points.K5: 刀片：工具装卸，用力远离手
points.K6: 针头：不回套、不徒手拆装
points.K7: 地上碎了：先隔开，告诉老师
points.K8: 碎玻璃不用手捡，用工具清理
points.K10: 锐器和碎玻璃进专用容器
points.K11: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃另行处理
points.K12: 被割被扎：冲洗止血，报告老师
points.S1: 锐器盒标识清楚，满了封口交接

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一个专用碎玻璃收集盒，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a sturdy broken-glass disposal box and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲锐器与碎玻璃安全。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰碰落一只烧杯，摔碎在地上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student knocks a beaker off the bench and it shatters on the floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰碰掉一只烧杯，摔碎了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他弯腰伸手要捡碎片，画面定格打叉
shots.prompt_en: He bends down to pick up the shards with bare hands; the frame freezes with a red X.
shots.narration: 他伸手就要捡，危险！

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤最常见，碎玻璃一碰就伤人
shots.scene: 实验室伤害统计图标：割伤刺伤排第一
shots.prompt_en: A simple bar chart icon where a cut-finger icon has the tallest bar. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 实验室最常见的伤，是割伤刺伤。
overlay: 割伤刺伤最常见，碎玻璃一碰就伤人

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤最常见，碎玻璃一碰就伤人
shots.scene: 碎玻璃锋利的边缘特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the sharp jagged edges of broken glass on a lab floor. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃常见，锋利边缘一碰就伤人。

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤最常见，碎玻璃一碰就伤人
shots.scene: 针头、刀片、碎玻璃、毛细管四类锐器图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a needle, a scalpel blade, broken glass and a capillary tube. No text.
shots.narration: 针头、刀片、碎玻璃，都是锐器。

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿用前查裂纹缺口
shots.scene: 【实拍】把烧瓶举向光线转一圈，检查裂纹和缺口（手部特写，戴手套）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands holding a flask up to the light and rotating it to check for cracks.
shots.narration: 用前对着光，转一圈查裂纹。
overlay: 玻璃器皿用前查裂纹缺口

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿用前查裂纹缺口
shots.scene: 星状裂纹、发丝细纹、瓶口缺口三种破损放大图
shots.prompt_en: Magnified views of a star crack, a hairline crack and a chipped rim on glassware. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 星裂、细纹、缺口，都要留意。

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿用前查裂纹缺口
shots.scene: 有裂纹的烧瓶一加热就炸裂的示意
shots.prompt_en: A cracked flask on a heating mantle splits apart in a simple animated illustration. No people.
shots.narration: 有伤的器皿，加热减压更易碎。

shots.section_title: 玻璃器皿用前查裂纹缺口
shots.scene: 破损器皿交给王老师，换一只新的
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a cracked flask to the safety administrator and takes a new one.
shots.narration: 发现破损不再用，交老师处理。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋
shots.scene: 硬把玻璃管往胶塞里推，玻璃管折断，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A glass tube forced into a rubber stopper snaps, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 最怕把玻璃管硬往塞子里插。
overlay: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋
shots.scene: 【实拍】用水润湿玻璃管和塞孔，手垫布握住（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a glass tube and a stopper hole are wetted with water; the hand holds the tube through a cloth.
shots.narration: 先用水或润滑剂润湿，手垫上布。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋
shots.scene: 【实拍】手握在靠近塞子处，慢慢旋转送入（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the hand grips the tube close to the stopper and slowly twists it in.
shots.narration: 手握靠近塞子处，慢慢旋进去。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋
shots.scene: 另一只手掌放在玻璃管对面，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A palm placed opposite the end of the glass tube is crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 另一只手，别放在管子对面。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋
shots.scene: 毛细管插不进时停手，不硬按
shots.prompt_en: A thin capillary tube meets resistance; the hand stops instead of pressing harder. No faces.
shots.narration: 毛细管插不进，别硬按。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润湿、近握、慢旋
shots.scene: 磨口卡死，交给老周处理
shots.prompt_en: A stuck ground-glass joint is handed to the older man instead of being forced.
shots.narration: 磨口卡死别蛮拧，交有经验的人。

shots.section_title: 切玻璃、剪丝：戴好防护，切口朝下
shots.scene: 切玻璃前戴护目镜、防割手套和实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on goggles, cut-resistant gloves and a lab coat before cutting glass.
shots.narration: 切玻璃，戴护目镜和防割手套。
overlay: 切玻璃、剪丝：戴好防护，切口朝下

shots.section_title: 切玻璃、剪丝：戴好防护，切口朝下
shots.scene: 玻璃碎屑用刷子扫，用手抹打叉
shots.prompt_en: Glass chips are brushed away with a small brush; wiping them by hand is crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 碎屑用刷子扫，别用手抹。

shots.section_title: 切玻璃、剪丝：戴好防护，切口朝下
shots.scene: 剪焊丝时剪口朝下，线头放进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Wire is cut with the cut end pointing down, and the snipped end goes into a sharps box. No faces.
shots.narration: 剪丝口朝下，线头进锐器盒。

shots.section_title: 刀片：工具装卸，用力远离手
shots.scene: 镊子夹住材料，刀口朝下朝外切
shots.prompt_en: Tweezers hold plant tissue on a cutting board while a scalpel cuts downward and away. No faces.
shots.narration: 镊子固定材料，刀口朝下朝外。
overlay: 刀片：工具装卸，用力远离手

shots.section_title: 刀片：工具装卸，用力远离手
shots.scene: 手心托着材料打孔、切片，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Holding material in the palm while punching or slicing it is crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 别把材料托在手心里切。

shots.section_title: 刀片：工具装卸，用力远离手
shots.scene: 用持针器装卸刀片，手指捏刀片打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blade is mounted on a scalpel handle with a needle holder; pinching the blade with fingers is crossed out.
shots.narration: 装卸刀片用工具，不用手指捏。

shots.section_title: 刀片：工具装卸，用力远离手
shots.scene: 递刀时刀柄朝向对方，刀尖朝下
shots.prompt_en: A scalpel is passed handle first with the blade pointing down. No faces.
shots.narration: 刀尖不对人，递刀柄朝对方。

shots.section_title: 针头：不回套、不徒手拆装
shots.scene: 注射后针头和注射器脱开的示意
shots.prompt_en: A needle separates from a syringe after an injection in a simple illustration. No people.
shots.narration: 针头脱开，别用手去取。
overlay: 针头：不回套、不徒手拆装

shots.section_title: 针头：不回套、不徒手拆装
shots.scene: 双手回套针帽，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A two-handed attempt to recap a used needle is crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 用过的针头，不回套针帽。

shots.section_title: 针头：不回套、不徒手拆装
shots.scene: 徒手拆装针头打叉，用镊子夹起掉落针头
shots.prompt_en: Removing a needle by hand is crossed out; tweezers pick up a dropped needle. No faces.
shots.narration: 不徒手拆装，掉了用镊子夹。

shots.section_title: 针头：不回套、不徒手拆装
shots.scene: 锐器盒放在手边，用完立即投入
shots.prompt_en: A sharps container sits within reach on the bench; a used syringe goes straight in. No faces.
shots.narration: 锐器盒放手边，用完立即投入。

shots.section_title: 针头：不回套、不徒手拆装
shots.scene: 选用针头不易脱开的一体式注射器
shots.prompt_en: A syringe with a locking needle connection gets a green check. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 选不易脱开的注射器和针头。

shots.section_title: 地上碎了：先隔开，告诉老师
shots.scene: 地上碎玻璃周围放提示牌围出区域
shots.prompt_en: Caution signs are placed around broken glass on the floor to cordon off the area. No people.
shots.narration: 地上碎了，先把这块地方隔开。
overlay: 地上碎了：先隔开，告诉老师

shots.section_title: 地上碎了：先隔开，告诉老师
shots.scene: 阿杰告诉王老师，老师拿来清扫工具
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tells the safety administrator, who brings a brush and dustpan.
shots.narration: 告诉老师，一起处理。

shots.section_title: 碎玻璃不用手捡，用工具清理
shots.scene: 徒手捡碎玻璃打叉，割伤让化学品进入血液的示意
shots.prompt_en: Picking up broken glass by hand is crossed out; a cut shows chemicals could enter the blood. No faces.
shots.narration: 绝不徒手捡，割伤会让化学品入血。
overlay: 碎玻璃不用手捡，用工具清理

shots.section_title: 碎玻璃不用手捡，用工具清理
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴手套用刷子和簸箕清扫碎玻璃（手部特写，用碎玻璃模拟片或无害玻璃）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands sweep broken glass into a dustpan with a brush.
shots.narration: 戴好手套，用刷子和簸箕扫。

shots.section_title: 碎玻璃不用手捡，用工具清理
shots.scene: 小碎片用镊子或钳子夹起
shots.prompt_en: Small glass fragments and a broken optical lens are picked up with tongs. No faces.
shots.narration: 小碎片和碎镜片，用镊子夹起。

shots.section_title: 碎玻璃不用手捡，用工具清理
shots.scene: 细碎玻璃用胶带粘起
shots.prompt_en: Fine glass splinters are lifted off the floor with adhesive tape. No faces.
shots.narration: 细碎的，用胶带粘干净。

shots.section_title: 水槽里不留东西
shots.scene: 水槽里泡着器皿，看不见底下的碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: A sink full of soapy water and glassware hides broken glass at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 水槽里的碎玻璃，最容易割手。

shots.section_title: 水槽里不留东西
shots.scene: 清洗完水槽清空，发现碎玻璃告诉老师
shots.prompt_en: The sink is emptied after washing; the student reports broken glass to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 洗完不留东西，有碎玻璃告诉老师。

shots.section_title: 锐器和碎玻璃进专用容器
shots.scene: 专用碎玻璃收集盒和锐器盒并排
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy broken-glass disposal box and a puncture-resistant sharps container side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃和锐器，进专用容器。
overlay: 锐器和碎玻璃进专用容器

shots.section_title: 锐器和碎玻璃进专用容器
shots.scene: 【实拍】把簸箕里的碎玻璃倒进专用碎玻璃收集盒（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass from a dustpan is poured into a dedicated broken-glass disposal box.
shots.narration: 倒进专用碎玻璃收集盒。

shots.section_title: 锐器和碎玻璃进专用容器
shots.scene: 碎玻璃扔进普通垃圾桶，清洁工被扎，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass in an ordinary trash bin pokes through the bag toward a cleaner's hand, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 绝不扔普通垃圾桶，免得伤人。

shots.section_title: 锐器和碎玻璃进专用容器
shots.scene: 碎镜片、断毛细管也放进碎玻璃盒
shots.prompt_en: A broken lens and a snapped capillary tube go into the broken-glass box. No faces.
shots.narration: 碎镜片、断管，同样处理。

shots.section_title: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃另行处理
shots.scene: 沾着化学品的碎玻璃，旁边有危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass wet with a chemical, next to a hazard icon. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃，要特殊处理。
overlay: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃另行处理

shots.section_title: 沾了化学品的碎玻璃另行处理
shots.scene: 三个收集容器分别对应：普通碎玻璃、化学污染、生物污染
shots.prompt_en: Three separate collection containers with different icons for clean glass, chemical and biological contamination. No text.
shots.narration: 分清污染类型，告诉老师再处理。

shots.section_title: 被割被扎：冲洗止血，报告老师
shots.scene: 被割伤的手指在流水下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A cut finger is rinsed under running water. No faces.
shots.narration: 被割被扎，先用流水冲洗。
overlay: 被割被扎：冲洗止血，报告老师

shots.section_title: 被割被扎：冲洗止血，报告老师
shots.scene: 用干净纱布按压止血，报告王老师
shots.prompt_en: Clean gauze is pressed on the wound, then the person reports to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 按压止血，报告老师，需要时就医。

shots.section_title: 锐器盒标识清楚，满了封口交接
shots.scene: 锐器盒上的标识和封口线
shots.prompt_en: A sharps container with a hazard label and a fill line marked near the top. No text.
shots.narration: 容器标识清楚，到线就封口。
overlay: 锐器盒标识清楚，满了封口交接

shots.section_title: 锐器盒标识清楚，满了封口交接
shots.scene: 封好的盒子交给学校废物收运人员
shots.prompt_en: A sealed sharps box is handed over to the facility engineer for collection.
shots.narration: 按学校规定登记交接，不混生活垃圾。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 查裂纹、慢旋、不回套依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A crack check, a slow twist of a tube and an uncapped needle in a sharps box get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 用前查裂纹，插管慢旋，针头不回套。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 刷子簸箕、碎玻璃盒、报告图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A brush and dustpan, a broken-glass box and a report icon get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 碎了不用手捡，专用容器收集。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在燃烧三角形图示旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fire triangle diagram made of icons and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲燃烧原理与火灾分类。
